['Remondis SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Remondis SE & Co. KG is a German multinational company specializing in recycling, water resource management, and industrial and communal services. It operates in over 800 locations in more than 30 countries, with more than 30,000 employees and an estimated revenue of 6.4 billion Euro in 2018. Remondis is part of the Rethmann Group.

['Liebherr-International Deutschland Gmb.company_description: Liebherr-International Deutschland GmbH is a German company that operates in the manufacturing of heavy equipment and machinery, including off-highway haul trucks and other industrial equipment. It is also involved in providing equipment to the German Army. Additionally, Liebherr-International Deutschland GmbH is part of the Liebherr Group, which is known for its diverse range of products including construction machinery, mining equipment, aerospace components, and more.
